drafts.product: 로지텍 코리아 리프트 버티컬 인체공학 무선 블루투스 마우스 LIFT VERTICAL, MR0094, 그래파이트
drafts.text:
아침에 노트북만 쓰다 보니 마우스 바꾸는 게 귀찮았어.
그때 로지텍 코리아 리프트 버티컬 무선 블루투스 마우스를 써봤어—세로형 디자인이라 움직임을 최소화하면서도 클릭이 정확해.
다만 처음 익히는 데 약간의 적응 시간이 필요하고, 맥에서는 호환 확인이 필요해.
프로필에 코드 106 입력하면 확인할 수 있어.

이 게시물은 쿠팡 파트너스 활동의 일환으로, 이에 따른 일정액의 수수료를 제공받습니다.

hard_fails.detail: A compatibility/review claim has no supplied evidence.

judge_explanation.hook: Opening line is relatable and catches attention but not exceptionally striking.
judge_explanation.persona_fit: Mentions developers and long coding sessions, aligning well with the target persona.
judge_explanation.purchase_intent: Mentions product and affiliate disclosure but lacks a direct purchase call‑to‑action.
judge_explanation.specificity: Provides some product details and adaptation note, but many claims are vague and lack data.
judge_explanation.authenticity: Personal anecdote adds some authenticity, yet health benefit claim is unsupported.
judge_explanation.trust: Affiliate disclosure is present, but unsubstantiated ergonomic claim reduces credibility.
judge_explanation.cta_quality: No clear CTA to buy; the code‑106 note is ambiguous for purchase intent.
judge_explanation.policy_safety: Disclosure present and no prohibited content; only risk is unverified health claim.
judge_explanation.redundancy: Content is concise with no unnecessary repetition.
